d:
So close, yet so far for the Royals!
Paul Walter's quick-fire fifty, backed by valuable contributions from the rest of the batting unit, powered Arabian Aces to a commanding total. Chasing 125, Royal Desert Champions, led by Nicholas Pooran, fell short by just 11 runs as the Aces registered their fifth win of the campaign!
